flashcard_questions.q: Pardoning someone for what they have done wrong and choosing to let go of anger, resentment or the desire for revenge.
The prayer Jesus taught his disciples, which includes the request 'forgive us our sins, as we forgive those who sin against us'.
One of the 99 names of Allah, meaning 'the All-Forgiving', emphasising God's limitless capacity to pardon.

flashcard_questions.a: A non-religious worldview based on reason, ethics and human welfare, without reference to the supernatural.
The restoration of harmony between people or groups who have been in conflict, going beyond forgiveness to rebuild trust.
